ai.summary: FreebuffModelSelector gains an optional nowMs prop to freeze the picker's clock at a specific epoch millisecond. eli5.text: You may have noticed that the assistant picker on the CLI sometimes hid rows like V4 Pro depending on what time of day it loaded, because some tiers are temporarily unavailable during DeepSeek's peak-cost window (00:00-10:00 UTC). This only affects automated/CLI-driven sessions that pass the pin value; in normal use the picker keeps reading the real clock so tiers reopen naturally without restarting. The change is live today in the CLI build.

Alongside this, the placements metric dictionary and prepaid top-up rules land in common so advertisers get a single source of truth for spend, CTR, activations, and balance validation, while a getZonedYmd helper joins the zoned-time utilities for day-string math, and freebuff-ads.ts gains isServableLandingUrl plus normalizeUrlInput to gate unsafe landing URLs before the terminal card renderer ever sees them.
ai.evidence: Moved inline ad layout functions (getInlineAdLayout, truncateToWidth, truncateToLines, getAdDisplayLabel, extractDomain, INLINE_AD_DISCLOSURE, INLINE_AD_GAP, INLINE_AD_LINK_SUFFIX, MAX_DESC_LINES, MIN_INLINE_WIDTH_WITH_DESTINATION) from cli/src/components/ad-banner.tsx into a new common/src/ads/inline-ad-layout.ts, and added isServableLandingUrl and normalizeUrlInput to common/src/constants/freebuff-ads.ts; also added freebuff-placements.ts, freebuff-topups.ts, and getZonedYmd to zoned-time.ts.

changes.what: Extracted inline ad layout functions and constants into a shared module so the CLI and advertiser campaign builder render creatives identically at the documented preview widths.
Added the placements metric dictionary with CTR/cost/ecpm math, display statuses, not-serving reasons, and the PLACEMENTS_CONSOLE_ENABLED gate set to false.
Added prepaid top-up limits and validators (AD_TOP_UP_MIN_CENTS, max, step, presets, product name, currency, spend ledger reasons) for the placements rail.
Added isServableLandingUrl and normalizeUrlInput to forgive missing URL schemes and reject non-http(s) destinations before rendering.
Added getZonedYmd to return the calendar day in a time zone as a YYYY-MM-DD string for day-string storage and display.
Re-exported extractDomain, getAdDisplayLabel, and getInlineAdLayout from common and removed their local definitions.

ai.summary: Added AD_RESET_TIMEZONE = 'America/Los_Angeles' to common/src/constants/freebuff-ads.ts. Ads system daily boundaries (spend caps, engagement ceilings, delivery reporting, placements spend ledger day column) are Pacific calendar days, aligning with existing product daily budgets. eli5.text: Ads now reset every day at midnight Pacific Time instead of at some other moment, so your daily spending and placement limits all turn over together. This only matters if you run or see ads in the system, and you would notice that your budget and stats roll over at the same clock hour that the product's other daily limits already do. The change went live today and is ready for advertisers and the payment system to use.
